title: Emergency button and convenience annoyances
summary: Reviews in this topic describe convenience frustrations, especially with the emergency light button, repeated startup actions, and the inconvenience of needing a loaner car.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on a hard-to-press emergency button, inconvenient repeated actions at startup, a non-adjustable rear seat angle, slower-than-expected response, and the hassle of using a loaner car.

limitations: This topic combines several different inconvenience issues, including control usability, seat adjustability, startup behavior, and loaner-car inconvenience, so the examples do not reflect a single tightly focused problem.
The sample contains only a few fragments, so examples are limited.
